connector.name: QnEvt Verifiable Randomness MCP
connector.registryDescription: Verifiable random decisions, audit sampling, fair selection, and proof verification using QnEvt.
connector.summary: Hosted at qnevt.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the nanakabu account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
